_comment: AI Visibility (NeuronWriter AI Tracker) opportunity intake. Source: AI Tracker > Opportunities export (project 9d0bec3a70f4743c). SEEDED with a partial paste on 2026-07-16 (6 of 74). PASTE THE FULL 74 HERE. Then run `node agents/ai-opportunities-intake.mjs` to upsert 'optimize' opportunities that have a `page` into agents/neuronwriter-targets.json so the weekly optimize/QA agents work them within the 75/mo quota. Opportunities with page:null are printed for a human to map to a route (or a new page/FAQ). type: 'optimize' = our own page can rank/answer better; 'mention' = a competitor page is being cited and we need our own answer. status: todo|in_progress|done|rejected. Do NOT auto-add 'mention'-only rows as targets; use them to decide new comparison/FAQ content.

opportunities.note: Answer-block: first 2-3 sentences must answer 'best mosquito control in Birmingham' naming the office + seasonal Mar-Nov offer.

opportunities.note: Reddit + Yelp are cited — needs third-party corroboration (reviews/citations) plus the comparison answer block. Already a priority-1 target.

opportunities.note: Add a Pelham 'free WDO termite inspection' answer block + FAQ; only Yelp is cited today, easy win.

opportunities.note: Cost intent maps to /pricing (which now publishes real 'from' rates) and/or the Birmingham page. Ensure the first answer block gives a plain-language price range.
